question: How does species/catalog-blocked internal prediction differ from a pooled allometry fit, and can an exact observed subset update genuinely invalidate/refit a dependent allometry prediction?

model.method: OLS via numpy.linalg.lstsq; same model form as connectors/fish_controls/build.py:fit, no download/bootstrap rerun
model.no_tuning: Fixed model/form/nominal band; no held-out response influences estimation/selection

blocking.species: Within each group, hold out each species completely; purge training rows sharing any catalog token with that test species
blocking.catalog: Within each group, connected components of shared digit catalog tokens; hold out each whole component; no row-wise shuffle
blocking.identity_unknown: Refuse unparseable/empty catalog identities rather than assume independence
blocking.comparison_scope: Two internal-validation schemes reuse the same observations; never pool their scores as independent replicates. Only3 flying-fish species, not population-level species transfer.

uncertainty.noise: training-only residual sum of squares/(n-2), units log10(cm)^2
uncertainty.parameter_covariance: catalog-component delete-one jackknife covariance, only when>=3 components and every delete-one fit is full-rank with n>=3
uncertainty.working_prediction_band: beta prediction ±1.959963984540054*sqrt(h Cov_jackknife hT + training_noise_variance); back-transform endpoints to cm
uncertainty.scope: Nominal Gaussian working band, not calibrated95% confidence/coverage guarantee; catalog groups are dependence proxies, not established independent animals. Missing/degenerate uncertainty stays null.

update_demo.catalog_purge: remove training rows sharing held-out tokens at both versions
update_demo.dependent_query: median SL of version1 eligible training rows; same query for both versions
update_demo.cache: exact model version+query digest; requestv2 againstv1 cache must raise stale result error, retainv1, explicitly recomputev2; report change, never presume improved prediction

controls: analytic noiseless power law recovers coefficients
heldout response mutation cannot alter training fit/noise/jackknife band
shared catalog labels never cross fold
bad source ratios remain unchanged, missingness retained
stale model cache refuses old result, refreshed prediction is actually recomputed
reporting: All folds/endpoints/residuals/missing/failed fits and band misses retained. No pass threshold or biological/casual/flight success inferred. Existing planner API unchanged. Adapter drafts only if schema/licensegate valid; no DB write/ready/lease/acceptance claimed.
